opening.argument: Bitconnect is presented as an investment opportunity built around putting money into a loan system, promising a projected increase from $100 to $1,000,000 in about three years. The speaker ties bonus payments to the loan, urges viewers to reinvest earnings promptly, and presents a larger loan as a way to reach the projected returns sooner. A spreadsheet reinforces the structure with columns for daily interest, bonuses, reinvestment, and lending balance. The presentation directs viewers to join through a referral URL and relies on a stated guaranteed daily percentage, while the speaker still promotes the projections despite saying the modeled rate could be higher or lower and advising fearful viewers not to participate. Those qualifications do not remove the investment solicitation or its promised returns.
